The active version 9c18a01c was then verified byte-identical to the tested rebuild and live/ refreshed from it.
_scope: Merge Serp Results (records each SerpAPI call's final state per search in sd.hhSerpHealth) and Prepare Complete Search (turns it into counts, adds serpHealth to the completion body, deletes it). No node added or removed, no connection changed.
_why: A search can fall short because the search engine failed (SerpAPI 503: 3 of 11 saved real searches) or because Google ignored site:linkedin.com/in/ (5 of 43 page-1 calls with results came back without a single LinkedIn profile), and the recruiter is told neither. The workflow does not know the recruiter's language, so it sends counts only; the page words them (owner decisions 2026-10-02: only when the search fell short, never suggest searching again).
_expectedEffect: The completion body gains serpHealth {calls, failed, ignoredFilter} whenever at least one SerpAPI call was made; every other field, every send, every paid call and every routing decision is unchanged. Counts are per distinct (query, page) in its final state, so a phase-1 503 that phase 2 retried with an answer is not counted as failed. No query text leaves n8n.
_knownLimits: Nothing shows the counts until the backend stores serpHealth and the page displays it (separate, same delivery). Partial pages (some LinkedIn profiles among other results) count as answered, not as ignored. A Google 'no results' answer counts as answered (empty), not failed. sd.hhSerpHealth is pruned after 24 hours and deleted by the completion; a search that never completes leaves its entry until the prune.
